name: D2C application approvals
description: A contract-governed D2C approval event product that preserves transactional outbox parity, at-least-once delivery, and idempotent operational consumption.

fields.handling: Treat as restricted at query boundaries; do not add raw customer attributes to this event contract.
Use only for approval-domain joins and retain access controls with the downstream serving layer.

service_levels.name: outbox-parity
service_levels.measurement: Prometheus gauge compared from approval and outbox database truth at scrape time.

service_levels.name: publisher-backlog
service_levels.objective: d2c_outbox_backlog < 100 while the publisher is healthy
service_levels.measurement: Prometheus gauge of unpublished transactional outbox rows.

service_levels.name: consumer-recovery
service_levels.measurement: Kafka partition lag exported by the idempotent consumer.

quality_rules.name: contract-shape
quality_rules.rule: Every emitted approval event must conform to the versioned JSON Schema before it becomes a supported interface.

quality_rules.name: event-id-uniqueness
quality_rules.rule: The operational sink uses event_id as its primary key and treats a replayed event as a duplicate rather than a second fact.

quality_rules.name: lake-freshness-and-reconciliation
quality_rules.rule: Each Spark batch must classify every Kafka source record as a fact or quarantine row, and replaying the same source ranges must not add fact, quarantine, or audit records.

quality_rules.name: contract-violation-quarantine
quality_rules.rule: A malformed or contract-violating Kafka record must be retained once by topic, partition, and offset instead of stopping the approval analytics stream.

assets.name: Application approved event v1
assets.description: Immutable approval event written into the same PostgreSQL transaction as the application row and published from the transactional outbox.

assets.name: D2C application events operational sink
assets.description: Idempotent DuckDB operational sink for approved events, used to demonstrate replay-safe consumer persistence before an analytics lakehouse sink is introduced.

assets.name: D2C application events analytics table
assets.description: Checkpointed Spark Structured Streaming fact table for incremental D2C approval analytics with immutable event-id reconciliation at the Apache Iceberg boundary.

assets.name: D2C application events quarantine table
assets.description: Restricted Iceberg quarantine table for malformed and contract-violating approval records, preserving Kafka source coordinates for deterministic remediation.
